```{r setup}
# ============================================================
# Every number in this document is computed here or inline from
# saved aggregate results in the repository. Nothing is typed by
# hand except method constants. Missing files stop the render.
# Paths are relative to this file: the repository root is ../../..
# ============================================================
library(knitr)
ROOT <- normalizePath(file.path("..", "..", ".."))
OUT <- file.path(ROOT, "results", "benchmark_sim", "outputs")

#' Read a saved CSV under results/benchmark_sim/outputs, failing loudly.
#' @param ... path components below OUT
#' @return data.frame
rd <- function(...) {
  p <- file.path(OUT, ...)
  if (!file.exists(p)) stop("Missing saved evidence: ", p)
  read.csv(p, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}

#' Reuse a verified Chapter 4 exhibit in the current output format.
#' @param stem Basename of the Chapter 4 vector figure without an extension.
#' @return The knitr image object for the figure and its caption.
#' @examples
#' # chapter_figure("sup_external_c")
chapter_figure <- function(stem) {
  image_path <- if (knitr::is_html_output()) {
    file.path("figures", paste0(stem, ".svg"))
  } else {
    file.path("..", "..", "prelim", "figures", paste0(stem, ".pdf"))
  }
  knitr::include_graphics(image_path)
}

# Number formatting: fixed decimals, a true minus sign, signed differences.
sci <- function(x, digits = 0) { e <- floor(log10(x)); paste0("$", formatC(x / 10^e, format = "f", digits = digits), " \\times 10^{", e, "}$") }
num <- function(x, d = 3) gsub("-", "−", formatC(x, format = "f", digits = d))
sgn <- function(x, d = 3) ifelse(x > 0, paste0("+", num(x, d)), num(x, d))
ci  <- function(lo, hi, d = 3) paste0(num(lo, d), " to ", num(hi, d))
pct <- function(x, d = 0) paste0(formatC(100 * x, format = "f", digits = d), "%")
big <- function(x) formatC(x, format = "d", big.mark = ",")
andj <- function(x) sub(", ([^,]*)$", " and \\1", paste(x, collapse = ", "))  # "1, 2 and 3"

# Display names and platforms of the external series (design facts).
cohort_label <- c(Dijk = "Dijk", Moffitt_GEO_array = "Moffitt",
                  PACA_AU_array = "PACA-AU array", PACA_AU_seq = "PACA-AU RNA-seq",
                  Puleo_array = "Puleo")
cohort_platform <- c(Dijk = "RNA-seq", Moffitt_GEO_array = "Microarray",
                     PACA_AU_array = "Microarray", PACA_AU_seq = "RNA-seq",
                     Puleo_array = "Microarray")
```

```{r load-evidence}
# ---- Training data (S-11) ----
# The folds do not depend on the rank, and the permuted-outcome simulation (fitted at rank 7) is read
# from the rank-7 folder. Every other result of the working model is read from the
# rank-5 rebuild (docs/findings/2026-11-12-k5-exhibits-findings.md), whose subfolders
# mirror the rank-7 folders: s11, s12, prompt6_comparators, prompt7_desurv_style, prelim_ch4.
K5 <- "k5_working_2026-11-12"
s11_folds <- rd("yfb_supervised_real_2026-11-04", "folds.csv")
train_n   <- tapply(s11_folds$Freq, s11_folds$cohort, sum)
train_d   <- tapply(s11_folds$Freq[s11_folds$event == "1"],
                    s11_folds$cohort[s11_folds$event == "1"], sum)
s11_sum   <- rd(K5, "s11", "summary.csv")
s11_fits  <- rd(K5, "s11", "fits.csv")
s11_scr   <- rd(K5, "s11", "screen_paired.csv")
s11_null  <- rd("yfb_supervised_real_2026-11-04", "null_cells.csv")
s11_agree <- rd(K5, "s11", "size_agreement.csv")
genes     <- rd("single_log_check", "gene_sets.csv")

d4 <- subset(s11_sum, part == "size" & set == "D4")
cv_w1 <- d4[d4$arm == "w1", ]; cv_ts <- d4[d4$arm == "w0cox", ]
# Paired fold difference, supervised minus two-step, over the five CV folds.
ff <- subset(s11_fits, part == "size" & set == "D4" & fold > 0)
ff <- merge(ff[ff$arm == "w1", c("fold", "C", "converged")],
            ff[ff$arm == "w0cox", c("fold", "C")], by = "fold", suffixes = c("_w1", "_ts"))
cv_diff <- mean(ff$C_w1 - ff$C_ts); cv_diff_se <- sd(ff$C_w1 - ff$C_ts) / sqrt(nrow(ff))
cv_conv <- sum(ff$converged)
ff_iter <- subset(s11_fits, part == "size" & set == "D4" & arm %in% c("w1", "w0cox") & fold > 0)$n_iter
full_w1 <- subset(s11_fits, part == "size" & set == "D4" & arm == "w1" & fold == 0)
sz_w1   <- subset(s11_fits, part == "size" & arm == "w1")
share_rng <- range(sz_w1$share_alive_median, na.rm = TRUE)
sizes <- subset(s11_sum, part == "size" & arm %in% c("w1", "w0cox"))

# ---- External scoring of the fixed fit (S-12) ----
ext  <- rd(K5, "s12", "external_cindex.csv")
extd <- rd(K5, "s12", "external_paired_diff.csv")
pool_donor <- rd(K5, "s12", "external_paired_diff_donor.csv")
exth <- rd(K5, "s12", "external_pooled_hr.csv")
# The same pooled HR with donor-clustered intervals (the two PACA-AU series share donors).
exth_donor <- rd(K5, "prompt6_comparators", "pooled_hr.csv")
exth_donor <- exth_donor[match(exth$model, exth_donor$model), ]
stopifnot(isTRUE(all.equal(exth_donor$hr, exth$hr_per_sd)))
e_w1 <- ext[ext$model == "w1", ]; e_ts <- ext[ext$model == "twostep", ]
# Calibration-slope SEs of the two fits, from the comparator panel's series table.
cal_tab <- subset(rd(K5, "prompt6_comparators", "external.csv"), model %in% c("w1", "twostep"))
cal_w1 <- cal_tab[cal_tab$model == "w1", ][match(e_w1$cohort, cal_tab$cohort[cal_tab$model == "w1"]), ]
cal_ts <- cal_tab[cal_tab$model == "twostep", ][match(e_w1$cohort, cal_tab$cohort[cal_tab$model == "twostep"]), ]
stopifnot(isTRUE(all.equal(cal_w1$cal_slope, e_w1$cal_slope)),
          isTRUE(all.equal(cal_ts$cal_slope, e_ts$cal_slope[match(e_w1$cohort, e_ts$cohort)])))
cal_gap <- abs(cal_w1$cal_slope - cal_ts$cal_slope)
stopifnot(all(cal_gap < pmin(cal_w1$cal_se, cal_ts$cal_se)))
cal_se_rng <- range(c(cal_w1$cal_se, cal_ts$cal_se))
pool5  <- extd[grepl("5 cohorts", extd$cohort), ]
poolns <- extd[grepl("without", extd$cohort), ]
ext_records <- sum(e_w1$n); ext_deaths <- sum(e_w1$events)
donors <- read.csv("paca-au-donor-audit.csv")
ext_people <- ext_records - donors$shared_donors - (donors$seq_records - donors$seq_donors)
s15 <- rd(K5, "s15", "verdict.csv")
s15_curve <- rd(K5, "s15", "weight_curve.csv")

s15_nested <- rd(K5, "s15", "nested_cv.csv")
kl2 <- rd("flat_beta_pruning_rerun_2026-11-06", "summary.csv")
ch4_dir <- file.path(K5, "prelim_ch4")
programs <- rd(ch4_dir, "programs_table.csv")
# Rank-5 programs matched to the rank-7 programs by training score correlation.
k5_match <- rd(K5, "program_correspondence", "matches.csv")
k5_unmatched <- rd(K5, "program_correspondence", "k7_unmatched.csv")
stopifnot(identical(k5_match$k5_program, k5_match$k7_match), !any(k5_unmatched$k7_active))
program_cor <- rd(ch4_dir, "programs_correspondence.csv")
program_enrich <- rd(ch4_dir, "programs_enrichment.csv")
program_subtype <- rd(ch4_dir, "programs_subtype_concordance.csv")
program_external <- rd(ch4_dir, "external_program_direction.csv")
program_active <- programs$program[programs$active]
matched_loadings <- subset(program_cor, comparison == "w_S=1 vs w_S=0" & new_program == other_program)
slope_match <- match(e_w1$cohort, e_ts$cohort)
stopifnot(nrow(e_w1) == nrow(e_ts), !anyNA(slope_match),
          setequal(matched_loadings$new_program, programs$program),
          setequal(program_external$program, program_active),
          nrow(program_external) == length(program_active) * nrow(e_w1),
          all(cv_w1$folds_converged == 5, cv_ts$folds_converged == 5))
calibration_closer <- abs(e_w1$cal_slope - 1) < abs(e_ts$cal_slope[slope_match] - 1)

# ---- Simulation: survival weight at 2,000 genes (S-9) ----
s9_design <- rd("yfb_survival_weight_2026-11-04", "grid", "design.csv")
s9_large_p <- max(s9_design$p)
s9_summ  <- rd("yfb_survival_weight_2026-11-04", "grid", "summary.csv")
s9_cv    <- rd("yfb_survival_weight_2026-11-04", "grid", "cv_chosen_cells.csv")
s9_choices <- rd("yfb_survival_weight_2026-11-04", "grid", "cv_chosen.csv")

s9_w1    <- s9_summ[s9_summ$arm == "w1", ]
s9_w1_2k <- s9_w1[s9_w1$p == s9_large_p, ]

s9_metrics <- rd("yfb_survival_weight_2026-11-04", "grid", "metrics.csv")
s9_exact <- rd("yfb_survival_weight_2026-11-04", "grid", "cal_slope_exact.csv")
s9_slopes <- aggregate(cal_slope_exact ~ variance, subset(s9_exact, p == s9_large_p & arm == "w1"), median)
s9_p2000 <- subset(s9_metrics, p == s9_large_p)
s9_nonconvergent <- subset(s9_p2000, w_S >= 40)
s9_fixed_share <- subset(s9_p2000, arm == "w1")

# ---- Simulation: weight chosen by CV (S-13) and near threshold (S-14) ----
s13   <- rd("yfb_supervision_strength_2026-11-05", "selected_vs_twostep.csv")
s13v  <- rd("yfb_supervision_strength_2026-11-05", "verdict.csv")
fa13  <- rd("yfb_supervision_strength_2026-11-05", "false_active_contribution.csv")
s14   <- rd("yfb_near_threshold_2026-11-05", "metrics.csv")
fa14  <- rd("yfb_near_threshold_2026-11-05", "false_active_contribution.csv")
s14a  <- aggregate(cbind(recovered, abs_r, false_active, c_validation, oracle_c) ~
                     strength + share + arm, s14, mean)
# Paired validation C difference, A1 at w_S = 1 minus two-step, per dataset.
s14p <- merge(s14[s14$arm == "A1_w1", c("seed", "share", "strength", "c_validation")],
              s14[s14$arm == "twostep", c("seed", "share", "strength", "c_validation")],
              by = c("seed", "share", "strength"), suffixes = c("_a1", "_ts"))
s14p$d <- s14p$c_validation_a1 - s14p$c_validation_ts
s14d <- aggregate(d ~ strength + share, s14p, function(z) c(mean = mean(z), wins = sum(z > 0)))
s14d <- do.call(data.frame, s14d)
fa13_cells <- aggregate(other_share ~ cell + arm, fa13, median)
fa13_c <- aggregate(delta_c ~ cell + arm, fa13, mean)
fa14 <- subset(fa14, arm %in% c("A1_w1", "twostep"))
fa14_share <- aggregate(other_share ~ strength + share + arm, fa14, median)
fa14_c <- aggregate(delta_c ~ strength + share + arm, fa14, mean)
fa14_cells <- merge(fa14_share, fa14_c, by = c("strength", "share", "arm"))
fa14_small <- subset(fa14_cells, share == min(share))
fa14_larger <- subset(fa14_cells, share > min(share))
s14_n <- length(unique(s14$seed))
s14_shares <- sort(unique(s14$share))
s14_oracle <- aggregate(oracle_c ~ strength + share, subset(s14, arm == "A1_w1"), mean)
s14_oracle_ranges <- tapply(s14_oracle$oracle_c, s14_oracle$strength, function(z) ci(min(z), max(z), 2))
stopifnot(all(s9_fixed_share$recovered), all(s9_fixed_share$converged),
          !any(s9_nonconvergent$converged), all(s14$converged),
          nrow(s9_choices) == nrow(s9_design))
s13_joint_delta <- merge(subset(s13, arm == "A1", select = c(cell, c_validation)),
                         subset(s13, arm == "A2", select = c(cell, c_validation)), by = "cell")

# ---- Priors on the scores, loadings and survival coefficients (Appendix D) ----
# Arm codes in the CSVs: PL = point-Laplace L and F on per-cohort z-scores (current
# model); PE = point-exponential on X/sd; RANK = point-exponential on within-patient
# ranks; SZ = point-exponential on shifted z-scores; PES = PE input with cohort strata.
# Coefficient arms: PL = per-program Normal; B_PLAP, B_PN, B_NSH = shared
# point-Laplace, point-normal and Normal priors. Fold 0 is the full training fit.
lfp <- "lf_prior_2026-11-09"
lf_sim   <- rd(lfp, "sim_cells.csv")
lf_simf  <- rd(lfp, "sim_fits.csv")
lf_fits  <- rd(lfp, "real_fits.csv")
lf_pair  <- rd(lfp, "real_paired.csv")
lf_prog  <- rd(lfp, "real_programs.csv")
lf_audit <- rd(lfp, "real_input_audit.csv")
a2_sim   <- rd(lfp, "a2", "a2_sim_cells.csv")
a2_fits  <- rd(lfp, "a2", "a2_real_fits.csv")
a2_pair  <- rd(lfp, "a2", "a2_real_paired.csv")
b_sim    <- rd(lfp, "beta_sim_cells.csv")
b_simf   <- rd(lfp, "beta_sim_fits.csv")
b_fits   <- rd(lfp, "beta_real_fits.csv")
b_pair   <- rd(lfp, "beta_real_paired.csv")
b_prog   <- rd(lfp, "beta_real_programs.csv")

prior_cells <- c("s14_0.05pct", "s9_0.25pct", "s9_1pct", "s9_5pct")
cell_share <- setNames(paste0(sub(".*_([0-9.]+)pct$", "\\1", prior_cells), "%"), prior_cells)
# Cell rows of one arm, in the order of prior_cells; stops if a cell is missing.
cell_rows <- function(d, a, col = "arm") {
  r <- d[d[[col]] == a, ][match(prior_cells, d$cell[d[[col]] == a]), ]
  stopifnot(nrow(r) == length(prior_cells), !anyNA(r$cell))
  r
}
lf_pl <- cell_rows(lf_sim, "PL"); lf_pe <- cell_rows(lf_sim, "PE")
lf_sz <- cell_rows(a2_sim, "SZ")
stopifnot(all(lf_sim$converged == lf_sim$n), all(a2_sim$converged == a2_sim$n),
          all(b_sim$converged == b_sim$n), all(b_simf$converged),
          length(unique(c(lf_sim$n, a2_sim$n, b_sim$n))) == 1)
prior_n_sim <- unique(lf_sim$n)

# Fold summaries (folds 1-5) of one arm: within-cohort C, convergence, active
# programs and the largest absolute correlation of a program with cohort.
fold_summary <- function(d, a, col = "arm") {
  f <- d[d[[col]] == a & d$fold > 0, ]
  stopifnot(nrow(f) == 5)
  data.frame(C = mean(f$C_within), conv = sum(f$converged),
             act_lo = min(f$n_active), act_hi = max(f$n_active),
             cohort_cor = max(f$max_abs_cor_cohort))
}
lf_real <- rbind(PL = fold_summary(lf_fits, "PL"), PE = fold_summary(lf_fits, "PE"),
                 PES = fold_summary(a2_fits, "PES", "setup"),
                 SZ = fold_summary(a2_fits, "SZ", "setup"),
                 RANK = fold_summary(lf_fits, "RANK"))
lf_diff <- rbind(PE = lf_pair[lf_pair$arm == "PE", c("diff_within", "se_within")],
                 PES = a2_pair[a2_pair$setup == "PES" & a2_pair$reference == "PL", c("diff_within", "se_within")],
                 SZ = a2_pair[a2_pair$setup == "SZ" & a2_pair$reference == "PL", c("diff_within", "se_within")],
                 RANK = lf_pair[lf_pair$arm == "RANK", c("diff_within", "se_within")])
# The saved paired means must agree with the fold-level files.
stopifnot(isTRUE(all.equal(lf_real["PL", "C"], unique(lf_pair$mean_C_within_PL))),
          isTRUE(all.equal(lf_real[c("PE", "RANK"), "C"], lf_pair$mean_C_within[match(c("PE", "RANK"), lf_pair$arm)])),
          sum(lf_prog$active[lf_prog$arm == "PE"]) == 0)
pe_alt <- c("PE", "PES", "SZ", "RANK")
stopifnot(all(-lf_diff$diff_within > lf_diff$se_within))
# False-active counts per fit at planted shares of 1% and above.
lf_big <- subset(lf_simf, cell %in% c("s9_1pct", "s9_5pct"))
lf_pe_big_min <- min(lf_big$false_active[lf_big$arm == "PE"])
lf_pl_big_max <- max(lf_big$false_active[lf_big$arm == "PL"])
gene_mean_xsd <- setNames(lf_audit$median_gene_mean[lf_audit$arm == "PE"],
                          lf_audit$cohort[lf_audit$arm == "PE"])
prior_n_train <- lf_fits$n_train[lf_fits$arm == "PL" & lf_fits$fold == 0]

# Coefficient priors: per-program Normal (current) and three shared priors.
b_arms <- c(PL = "Normal", B_PLAP = "Shared point-Laplace",
            B_PN = "Shared point-normal", B_NSH = "Shared Normal")
b_cells <- lapply(names(b_arms), function(a) cell_rows(b_sim, a))
names(b_cells) <- names(b_arms)
b_C <- c(PL = unique(b_pair$mean_C_within_Normal),
         setNames(b_pair$mean_C_within, b_pair$arm))[names(b_arms)]
b_active <- c(PL = unique(b_pair$mean_active_Normal),
              setNames(b_pair$mean_active, b_pair$arm))[names(b_arms)]
b_conv <- sapply(names(b_arms), function(a) sum(b_fits$converged[b_fits$arm == a & b_fits$fold > 0]))
stopifnot(isTRUE(all.equal(unname(b_C["PL"]), lf_real["PL", "C"])), all(b_conv == b_pair$folds_converged[1]))
# Spread of median calibration slopes across priors, by cell.
b_slope_spread <- sapply(prior_cells, function(cc) diff(range(b_sim$median_cal_slope[b_sim$cell == cc])))
b_pip_full <- subset(b_prog, arm == "B_PN" & fold == 0)
b_active_full <- b_pip_full$program[b_pip_full$active]
# Simulation: programs per fit with inclusion probability above 0.5 (saved as "p1;...;p7").
b_pn_fits <- subset(b_simf, arm == "B_PN")
# "NA" marks a program with no nonzero loadings (one per fit with six live programs);
# it counts as not included. Any other non-numeric entry stops the render.
b_pn_split <- strsplit(b_pn_fits$pip, ";")
stopifnot(all(sapply(b_pn_split, function(z) sum(z == "NA")) == 7 - b_pn_fits$n_alive))
b_pn_fits$n_incl <- sapply(b_pn_split, function(z) sum(as.numeric(z[z != "NA"]) > 0.5))
b_pn_incl <- tapply(b_pn_fits$n_incl, b_pn_fits$cell, mean)[prior_cells]

# ---- Training CV of the gene screen, input scaling and rank ----
# Input codes in the CSVs: D4_Z = current 2,218-gene screen, z-scores within cohort;
# D2_Z = variance screen after quantile normalization; D4_XSD = current screen divided
# by the within-cohort SD; D4_RANKZ = within-patient ranks, then z-scores within cohort.
# The D4_Z rows at K = 7 (part "reference") are the point-Laplace fits of the prior
# comparison. Fold 0 is the full training fit. C counts pairs within cohort.
tcv <- "training_cv_redo_2026-11-12"
tcv_fits   <- rd(tcv, "fits.csv")
tcv_k      <- rd(tcv, "k_curve.csv")
tcv_pair   <- rd(tcv, "paired.csv")
tcv_choice <- rd(tcv, "choices.csv")
tcv_a      <- rd(tcv, "a_rerun_paired.csv")
stopifnot(all(is.na(tcv_fits$error)), identical(as.integer(tcv_k$K), 2:12),
          all(tcv_k$n_folds == 5))
# Recompute each arm's fold mean, fold SE, paired difference from the K = 7 reference
# (paired SE over folds) and convergence count from the fold-level file.
tcv_cv  <- subset(tcv_fits, fold > 0)
tcv_ref <- subset(tcv_cv, input == "D4_Z" & K == 7)
tcv_arm <- function(inp, k) {
  a <- subset(tcv_cv, input == inp & K == k)
  a <- a[match(tcv_ref$fold, a$fold), ]
  stopifnot(nrow(a) == 5, !anyNA(a$fold))
  d <- a$C_within - tcv_ref$C_within
  c(mean = mean(a$C_within), se = sd(a$C_within) / sqrt(5),
    diff = mean(d), se_diff = sd(d) / sqrt(5), conv = sum(a$converged))
}
tcv_rank <- t(sapply(tcv_k$K, function(k) tcv_arm("D4_Z", k)))
tcv_full <- subset(tcv_fits, fold == 0 & input == "D4_Z")
stopifnot(isTRUE(all.equal(unname(tcv_rank[, "mean"]), tcv_k$mean_C_within)),
          isTRUE(all.equal(unname(tcv_rank[, "se"]), tcv_k$se_C_within)),
          isTRUE(all.equal(unname(tcv_rank[, "diff"]), tcv_k$diff_vs_K7)),
          isTRUE(all.equal(unname(tcv_rank[, "se_diff"]), tcv_k$se_diff_vs_K7)),
          all(tcv_rank[, "conv"] == tcv_k$folds_converged),
          all(tcv_full$n_active[match(tcv_k$K, tcv_full$K)] == tcv_k$full_active),
          # Every column keeps nonzero loadings at every rank, in every fit.
          all(subset(tcv_fits, input == "D4_Z")$n_alive == subset(tcv_fits, input == "D4_Z")$K),
          # The K = 7 reference equals the point-Laplace arm of the prior comparison.
          isTRUE(all.equal(unname(tcv_rank[tcv_k$K == 7, "mean"]), lf_real["PL", "C"])))
# One-SE rule: smallest K whose mean C is at least the best mean minus the best K's fold SE.
tcv_best <- tcv_k[which.max(tcv_k$mean_C_within), ]
tcv_thr  <- tcv_best$mean_C_within - tcv_best$se_C_within
tcv_K    <- min(tcv_k$K[tcv_k$mean_C_within >= tcv_thr])
stopifnot(tcv_K == tcv_k$K[tcv_k$selected], tcv_best$K == tcv_k$K[tcv_k$best],
          isTRUE(all.equal(tcv_thr, unique(tcv_k$threshold_1se))),
          tcv_choice$selected[tcv_choice$choice == "rank K"] == as.character(tcv_K))
tcv_plateau <- range(tcv_k$mean_C_within[tcv_k$K >= tcv_K])
tcv_low     <- range(tcv_k$mean_C_within[tcv_k$K < tcv_K])
tcv_r <- function(k, col) tcv_rank[tcv_k$K == k, col]
# Gene screen and input scaling at K = 7: keep the current input unless an alternative
# is better by more than one paired SE.
tcv_inputs <- c(D4_Z = "Current screen, z-scores within cohort (rank-7 reference)",
                D2_Z = "Variance screen after quantile normalization, z-scores within cohort",
                D4_XSD = "Current screen, divided by within-cohort SD",
                D4_RANKZ = "Current screen, within-patient ranks then z-scores")
tcv_in <- t(sapply(names(tcv_inputs), function(i) tcv_arm(i, 7)))
tcv_genes <- sapply(names(tcv_inputs), function(i) unique(tcv_fits$n_genes[tcv_fits$input == i]))
tcv_alt <- names(tcv_inputs)[-1]
stopifnot(isTRUE(all.equal(unname(tcv_in[tcv_alt, "diff"]), tcv_pair$diff_within[match(tcv_alt, tcv_pair$input)])),
          isTRUE(all.equal(unname(tcv_in[tcv_alt, "se_diff"]), tcv_pair$se_within[match(tcv_alt, tcv_pair$input)])),
          !any(tcv_pair$replaces_current), all(tcv_pair$diff_within <= tcv_pair$se_within),
          all(tcv_choice$selected[1:2] == tcv_choice$current[1:2]),
          is.numeric(tcv_genes), tcv_genes[["D4_Z"]] == 2218)
# Point-exponential on X/sd against point-Laplace on z-scores at the selected rank.
tcv_a_pe <- subset(tcv_fits, part == "a_rerun" & fold > 0)
stopifnot(nrow(tcv_a) == 1, tcv_a$K == tcv_K, nrow(tcv_a_pe) == 5,
          isTRUE(all.equal(tcv_a$mean_C_within_PL, unname(tcv_r(tcv_K, "mean")))),
          isTRUE(all.equal(tcv_a$mean_C_within_PE, mean(tcv_a_pe$C_within))))
```
